title: Festival Cutdown Studies
description: Five independent studies for square festival promo surfaces such as map cards, wristband promos, artist carousel tiles, and info boards.
creative_direction: Independent assets should feel like real festival rollout surfaces: artist hierarchy, modular information placeholders, atmospheric stage energy, and social-share friendliness without readable names or sponsor marks.
